content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Billings

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of required project management education hours. Crucially, no prior work experience is necessary—making CAPM ideal for career-switchers and early-stage professionals entering project roles across Billings's healthcare, energy, and infrastructure sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp format. Our intensive course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, processes, and exam domains. You'll learn alongside professionals from Billings's major employers while maintaining your work schedule—all delivered entirely online.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your CAPM application once your education is complete. You'll pay the PMI exam fee at registration. Our team will guide you through the application portal to ensure all credentials and documentation meet PMI's requirements.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and final review sessions to build your confidence. The CAPM exam tests your knowledge of project management fundamentals across all five process groups. Schedule your Pearson VUE exam and sit for your credential attempt.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After earning CAPM, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Maintain your credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, conferences, and professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to support your ongoing career growth and credential renewal.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
